model_forms.M0: literal A4/P9 gains,4ms22slot p/v/q; causal self-generated capture targets, no future logs
model_forms.M1: exact Dense/GRU/previous action/history; named LP8ms hold and attitude4ms transport; 13-state plant effective thrust/drag/torque coefficients; latest-command4ms transport
model_forms.M2: M1 plus4 rotor-speed filter states, source asymmetric tau_up.0125/down.025; no further model class

fit.reads: ONLY formal development groups; observation-development flights validate mechanisms and code, not heldout model selection
fit.least_squares: bounded shared thrust in[0,20],three drag[0,5],three torque[-1000,1000],three angular drag[0,20]; velocity derivative only new LP samples
fit.M2_states: 4 execution states fixed from source; no GRU reduction or new neural weights
fit.selection: retain all3; training full causal rollout p/v/tilt and predicted safety/censoring reports, select smallest normalized score if complete; freeze models before heldout phase

prediction_information.allowed: one pre-stream initial state and initial clocks/history; SOURCE-generated task table and planned events; frozen model/weights
prediction_information.forbidden: future actual targets/observations/hidden states, actual event or termination times
prediction_information.isolation: bubblewrap read-only root with repository data and export hidden; only sanitized initial+plan+model inputs mounted; score runs outside sandbox
prediction_information.future_clock: nominal declared4ms control/8ms hold,20ms minimum publication; deterministic allowed subclass, not guaranteed actual scheduler
prediction_information.terminal_timing: known post-stream duration plus .5s declared uncertainty continuation under neural controller; actual termination stays scorer-only; outside range UNKNOWN

measurement.window: common source first planned gap through source post_stream end, including no-event arm; full profile and poststream exported
measurement.early_stop: right censored; no imputed tail; known failure counts even with censored peak; unknown remains unknown
measurement.pairs: fixed warmup/task/seed, report pre-first-event .5s p/v/geodesic attitude/action/hidden differences; not exact snapshot
measurement.combination: same absolute profile time and source trajectory; deltaAB-deltaA-deltaB; no alignment by shifted actual capture
measurement.phase: intent 0/2/6ms; actual read/LP phase and clock intervals; overlapping achieved distributions => NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
measurement.primary_and_task: original p5.failure_criteria and task tilt>45deg/altitude loss>1m side by side
measurement.recovery: original P0 bands .2m/.1m_s/.1rad_s continuous2s, gaps>20ms break continuity; after final capture at stopped trajectory
measurement.model_evaluation: one-step known-input and .5s/2s/full self-evolving rollouts; p/v/SO3/action/h/altitude where modelled; danger misses/false alarms/UNKNOWN, costs and repair ranking, success and failures separated

stops.new_error: STOP affected formal batch; preserve evidence; no retry/new version bypass
stops.critical_observation: STOP for missing control calls, invalid replay, identity confusion, protection anomaly
stops.infrastructure_pending: same-semantic pending continuation only after stopped processes/unique identity/output audit; every begun id permanently counted and never rerun
stops.budget: no quota borrowing or extra replacement flights
